title: Years between drops: Queensland average vs Dublin's first recorded drop

source.name: Pitch drop experiments comparison
source.publisher: University of Queensland; Trinity College Dublin

notes: Queensland's experiment (begun 1930) has averaged roughly 8-13 years between its nine drops. Trinity College Dublin's own pitch-drop experiment, begun in 1944, did not have a drop caught on camera until 2013 -- the first time a drop fall had ever been filmed live for either experiment.
